title: Script Transformations v3.6
synopsis: Transformations are functions applied to variables (script variables, pseudo-variables, AVPs, static strings) to extract or modify values without altering the original input. They are enclosed in '{' and '}' and follow the variable name, which must be enclosed in '(' and ')'.

transformations.name: s.len
transformations.description: Return strlen of variable value

transformations.name: s.int
transformations.description: Converts the initial part of the given string to an integer value. Returns 0 if there were no digits at all.

examples.description: Convert string to integer and compare

transformations.name: s.md5
transformations.description: Returns the MD5 hash of the given input.

examples.description: Log MD5 hash of From username

transformations.name: s.reverse
transformations.description: Returns the input string in revers order.

transformations.name: s.substr
transformations.description: Return the substring starting at offset having size of length.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Starting index. Negative values count from the end.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Size of the substring. Must be positive.

examples.description: Get substring from index 1 to end

transformations.name: s.select
transformations.description: Return a field from the value of a variable based on separator and index.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Field index. Negative values count from the end.

transformations.name: s.encode.hexa
transformations.description: Return encoding in hexa of variable's value

transformations.name: s.decode.hexa
transformations.description: Return decoding from hexa of variable's value

transformations.name: s.escape.common
transformations.description: Return escaped string of variable's value. Characters escaped are ', ", and 0.

transformations.name: s.unescape.common
transformations.description: Return unescaped string of variable's value. Reverse of s.escape.common.

transformations.name: s.escape.user
transformations.description: Return escaped string of variable's value, changing to '%hexa' the characters that are not allowed in user part of SIP URI.

transformations.name: s.unescape.user
transformations.description: Return unescaped string of variable's value, changing '%hexa' to character code.

transformations.name: s.escape.param
transformations.description: Return escaped string of variable's value, changing to '%hexa' the characters that are not allowed in the param part of SIP URI.

transformations.name: s.unescape.param
transformations.description: Return unescaped string of variable's value, changing '%hexa' to character code.

transformations.name: s.tolower
transformations.description: Return string with lower case ASCII letters.

transformations.name: s.toupper
transformations.description: Return string with upper case ASCII letters.

transformations.name: s.index
transformations.description: Searches for one string within another starting at the beginning. Returns starting index or NULL.

transformations.name: s.rindex
transformations.description: Searches for one string within another starting at the end. Returns starting index or NULL.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset to start search before. Optional.

transformations.name: s.fill.left
transformations.description: Fills a string to the left with a char/string until the given final length is reached.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Character or string to fill with.

transformations.name: s.fill.right
transformations.description: Fills a string to the right with a char/string until the given final length is reached.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Character or string to fill with.

transformations.name: s.width
transformations.description: Truncates or expands the input to the given len. Expanding is done to the right with spaces.

transformations.name: s.trim
transformations.description: Strips any leading or trailing whitespace from the input string.

transformations.name: s.trimr
transformations.description: Strips any trailing whitespace from the input string.

transformations.name: s.triml
transformations.description: Strips any leading whitespace from the input string.

transformations.name: s.dec2hex
transformations.description: Converts a decimal(base 10) number to hexadecimal (in base 16), represented as string.

transformations.name: s.hex2dec
transformations.description: Converts a hexadecimal number (base 16) represented as string to decimal (base 10).

transformations.name: s.b64encode
transformations.description: Represents binary input data in an ASCII string format.

transformations.name: s.b64decode
transformations.description: Assumes input is a Base64 string and decodes as many characters as possible.

transformations.name: s.xor
transformations.description: Performs one or more logical XOR operations with the secret string parameter and the input string.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: The secret string to XOR against.

transformations.name: s.eval
transformations.description: Interprets the string as a variable formatted string, evaluating all the variables declared in it.

transformations.name: s.date2unix
transformations.description: Assumes the input is an RFC-3261 SIP Date header value and returns the equivalent UNIX timestamp.

examples.description: Convert SIP Date to UNIX timestamp

transformations.name: s.sha1
transformations.description: Returns the SHA1 hash of the given input.

transformations.name: s.sha224
transformations.description: Returns the SHA224 hash of the given input.

transformations.name: s.sha256
transformations.description: Returns the SHA256 hash of the given input.

transformations.name: s.sha384
transformations.description: Returns the SHA384 hash of the given input.

transformations.name: s.sha512
transformations.description: Returns the SHA512 hash of the given input.

transformations.name: s.sha1_hmac
transformations.description: Returns the SHA1 HMAC hash of the given input using key.

examples.code: xlog("SHA1 HMAC over From username using key 'secret': $(fU{s.sha1_hmac,secret})\n");

transformations.name: s.sha224_hmac
transformations.description: Returns the SHA224 HMAC hash of the given input using key.

examples.code: xlog("SHA224 HMAC over From username using key 'secret': $(fU{s.sha224_hmac,secret})\n");

transformations.name: s.sha256_hmac
transformations.description: Returns the SHA256 HMAC hash of the given input using key.

examples.code: xlog("SHA256 HMAC over From username using key 'secret': $(fU{s.sha256_hmac,secret})\n");

transformations.name: s.sha384_hmac
transformations.description: Returns the SHA384 HMAC hash of the given input using key.

examples.code: xlog("SHA384 HMAC over From username using key 'secret': $(fU{s.sha384_hmac,secret})\n");

transformations.name: s.sha512_hmac
transformations.description: Returns the SHA512 HMAC hash of the given input using key.

examples.code: xlog("SHA512 HMAC over From username using key 'secret': $(fU{s.sha512_hmac,secret})\n");

transformations.name: uri.user
transformations.description: Returns the user part of the URI schema.

transformations.name: uri.host
transformations.description: Returns the domain part of the URI schema.

transformations.name: uri.passwd
transformations.description: Returns the password part of the URI schema.

transformations.name: uri.port
transformations.description: Returns the port of the URI schema.

transformations.name: uri.params
transformations.description: Returns all the URI parameters into a single string.

transformations.name: uri.param
transformations.description: Returns the value of URI parameter with name 'name'.

transformations.name: uri.headers
transformations.description: Returns URI headers.

transformations.name: uri.transport
transformations.description: Returns the value of transport URI parameter.

transformations.name: uri.ttl
transformations.description: Returns the value of ttl URI parameter.

transformations.name: uri.uparam
transformations.description: Returns the value of user URI parameter.

transformations.name: uri.maddr
transformations.description: Returns the value of maddr URI parameter.

transformations.name: uri.method
transformations.description: Returns the value of method URI parameter.

transformations.name: uri.lr
transformations.description: Returns the value of lr URI parameter.

transformations.name: uri.r2
transformations.description: Returns the value of r2 URI parameter.

transformations.name: uri.schema
transformations.description: Returns the schema part of the given URI.

transformations.name: via.name
transformations.description: Returns the protocol-name (of RFC3261 BNF), generally SIP.

transformations.name: via.version
transformations.description: Returns the protocol-version (of RFC3261 BNF), generally 2.0.

transformations.name: via.transport
transformations.description: Returns the transport (of RFC3261 BNF), e.g., UDP, TCP, TLS.

transformations.name: via.host
transformations.description: Returns the host portion of the sent-by (of RFC3261 BNF).

transformations.name: via.port
transformations.description: Returns the port portion of the sent-by (of RFC3261 BNF).

transformations.name: via.comment
transformations.description: The comment associated with the via header.

transformations.name: via.params
transformations.description: Returns all the Via headers parameters as single string.

transformations.name: via.param
transformations.description: Returns the value of Via header parameter with name 'name'.

transformations.name: via.branch
transformations.description: Returns the value of the branch parameter in the VIA header.

transformations.name: via.received
transformations.description: Returns the value of the received parameter in the VIA header, if any.

transformations.name: via.rport
transformations.description: Returns the value of the rport parameter in the VIA header, if any.

transformations.name: param.value
transformations.description: Returns the value of parameter 'name'.

transformations.name: param.exist
transformations.description: Returns 1 if the parameter 'name' exists, else 0.

transformations.name: param.valueat
transformations.description: Returns the value of parameter at position give by 'index' (0-based index).

examples.description: Get value of parameter at index 1

transformations.name: param.name
transformations.description: Returns the name of parameter at position 'index'.

examples.description: Get name of parameter at index 1

transformations.name: param.count
transformations.description: Returns the number of parameters in the list.

transformations.name: nameaddr.name
transformations.description: Returns the value of display name.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Optional index for list of nameaddr specs.

transformations.name: nameaddr.uri
transformations.description: Returns the value of URI.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Optional index for list of nameaddr specs.

transformations.name: nameaddr.len
transformations.description: Returns the length of the entire name-addr part from the value.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Optional index for list of nameaddr specs.

transformations.name: nameaddr.param
transformations.description: Returns the value of the parameter with name param_name.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Optional index for list of nameaddr specs.

transformations.name: nameaddr.params
transformations.description: Returns all the parameters and their corresponding values.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Optional index for list of nameaddr specs.

transformations.name: ip.pton
transformations.description: Returns a binary representation of a string represented IP.

transformations.name: ip.ntop
transformations.description: Returns a string representation of the binary IP provided.

transformations.name: ip.isip
transformations.description: Returns 1 if the string provided is a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address, otherwise 0.

transformations.name: ip.isip4
transformations.description: Returns 1 if the string provided is a valid IPv4, otherwise 0.

transformations.name: ip.isip6
transformations.description: Returns 1 if the string provided is a valid IPv6, otherwise 0.

transformations.name: ip.family
transformations.description: Returns INET or INET6 if the binary IP representation provided is IPv4 or IPv6.

transformations.name: ip.resolve
transformations.description: Returns the resolved IP address corresponding to the string domain provided.

transformations.name: ip.matches
transformations.description: Checks if the input IP address matches a net mask given as IP/masklen.

transformations.name: ip.isprivate
transformations.description: Checks if the input IP address is an IPv4 private IP, according to RFC 1918 and RFC 6598.

transformations.name: csv.count
transformations.description: Returns the number of entries in the provided CSV.

transformations.name: csv.value
transformations.description: Returns the entry at the specified positions. Indexing starts from 0.

transformations.name: sdp.line
transformations.description: Returns the specified line in the SDP body.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The line number of the type. Defaults to 0.

transformations.name: sdp.stream
transformations.description: Returns a specific stream (starting with the m= line) from an SDP body.

parameters.name: index_or_type
parameters.description: Index (int) or media type (string) of the stream.

transformations.name: sdp.stream-delete
transformations.description: Returns the specified SDP body with some of its streams deleted.

parameters.name: index_or_type
parameters.description: Index (int) or media type (string) of the stream to delete.

transformations.name: re.subst
transformations.description: Performs substitution using a regular expression.
